title: CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS in a settings file is ignored
symptoms: Monitor WebSocket watch fails with 'could not resolve' behind a proxy after 2.1.319
CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS set under env in settings.json has no effect
cause: From 2.1.319 settings files can no longer set CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS where the host manages the network. Only the process environment is honored.
fix: Remove it from settings files and export it in the shell or service environment that launches Claude Code.
